row.title: REDMAIN-1 has a second gate: openstd
row.body: Evidence: main failed python3 -m foundation openstd --check twice in two days (ops/perception-cost.jsonl, fixed by 37d2074da; ops/research/outcomes.jsonl, fixed in foundation/research.py) because a bot wrote a ledger row without the CloudEvents envelope, and the bot commit skips CI. doctrine/redmain.json listed one gate, deploy-site, so no repair ran for a red checks run. Change: doctrine/redmain.json gate open-standards runs scripts/openstd_gate.sh, the command .github/workflows/checks.yml runs too (GATE-PARITY-1), so ciwatch opens the repair as a pull request the lane merges. Probe: python3 -m foundation redmain --check and tests/foundation/test_redmain.py pass. Session: session_0156nqDuSa1pdM6rAaTQ1irE
